familyDerivationMeasurement.method: Requested 400;700 for eight additional variable families. Read one representative (last CSS rule) per weight descriptor, deduplicated by exact URL, and both static TTFs. All CSS rule/file counts recorded, but uninspected subset URLs omitted from follow-up requests. Original comparisons re-derived from their recorded profiles.
